title: Reasoning and the Trusting Behavior of DeepSeek and GPT: An Experiment Revealing Hidden Fault Lines in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the economic personality of LLMs through the lens of behavioral economics (the 'trust game'). While it discusses altruism as a background concept, its primary contribution is an empirical study of strategic and economic behavior rather than religion, formal moral philosophy, or ethical frameworks.
